.mcp.json.purpose: Project MCP servers for Claude Code: graphify (code graph from graphify-out/graph.json).

App/Data/AppEnvironment.swift.purpose: Composition root: builds shared services once.

App/Data/BackpackStore.swift.purpose: Backpack checklist storage in the App Group: the kid's own "always bring" items and per-day ticks.

App/Data/DataStore.swift.purpose: Single write gateway to SwiftData for all view models.

App/Data/NotificationScheduler.swift.purpose: Schedules the evening "tomorrow's schedule + homework" notification.

App/Data/ProfileStore.swift.purpose: The kid's profile in the App Group: name, grade, theme, onboarding flag; the photo is a JPEG file.

App/Data/ReminderSettings.swift.purpose: Evening reminder preferences, stored in the App Group.

App/Features/Backpack/BackpackView.swift.purpose: Today card: backpack progress, opens the packing checklist.

App/Features/Backpack/BackpackViewModel..purpose: Backpack checklist for one school day: a book per subject plus the kid's own items.

App/Features/Calendar/CalendarScreen.swi.purpose: Calendar tab: pick a day, see its lessons and marks.

App/Features/Calendar/CalendarViewModel..purpose: Calendar state: selected date, day snapshot, marked days.

App/Features/Calendar/MonthCalendarView..purpose: SwiftUI wrapper over the system `UICalendarView` with dot decorations.

App/Features/Lesson/LessonDetailView.swi.purpose: One lesson: note, photos (picker, camera, viewer).

App/Features/Lesson/LessonDetailViewMode.purpose: Lesson note and photos for a lesson route.

App/Features/Notes/NewNoteSheet.swift.purpose: Picks the subject and day for a new note, then opens the lesson screen, which holds the text, photos and scans.

App/Features/Notes/NotesView.swift.purpose: Notes tab: notes grouped by day.

App/Features/Profile/OnboardingView.swif.purpose: First launch, one question per screen: hello → name → photo or character → style.

App/Features/Profile/ProfileViewModel.sw.purpose: The kid's name, grade, photo and theme; also switches the app icon to match the theme.

App/Features/Profile/ProfileViews.swift.purpose: Round kid photo, or the first letter of the name on the theme color.

App/Features/Scan/DocumentScannerView.sw.purpose: System document camera (auto edge detection and perspective correction).

App/Features/Scan/ScanTimetableView.swif.purpose: Capture → OCR → review flow for the timetable.

App/Features/Scan/ScanViewModel.swift.purpose: Scan flow: image, OCR, parsed timetable, review phases.

App/Features/Scan/SubjectDictionary.swif.purpose: Snaps OCR'd subject names to known Armenian school subjects.

App/Features/Scan/TextRecognizer.swift.purpose: Text recognition protocol and its Vision implementation.

App/Features/Scan/TimetableParser+Cards..purpose: Card layout used by school e-diaries (weekly calendar view): one column per day, each lesson a card of `08:15 – 09:00` / subject (may wrap)

App/Features/Settings/SettingsViewModel..purpose: Settings state: period times drafts, reminder.

App/Features/Share/ShareInboxView.swift.purpose: Shown when a share arrives: what was received first, then where to put it.

App/Features/Share/ShareInboxViewModel.s.purpose: A received share: shows what came, then lets the kid choose where it goes before saving.

App/Features/Share/SharePackage+Transfer.purpose: Lets `ShareLink` send a SharePackage as a `.dasacucak` file, or as text where files are not taken.

App/Features/Tasks/TasksView.swift.purpose: Homework tab: grouped checklist and add sheet.

App/Features/Tasks/TasksViewModel.swift.purpose: Homework tasks grouped for the checklist.

App/Features/Timetable/SubjectPickerView.purpose: Picks a lesson's subject: the grade's official list (searchable), the kid's own subjects, or any typed name.

App/Features/Today/NowCard.swift.purpose: Hero card: what is happening right now (lesson, break, before school) with live countdowns, or the first lesson of the next school day.

App/Features/Today/TodayView.swift.purpose: Today tab: focus day lessons, current period, tasks.

App/Features/Today/TodayViewModel.swift.purpose: Today state: focus-day snapshot, current period.

App/Info.plist.purpose: App Info.plist (camera and photo usage, keys build settings cannot express).

App/SchoolSchedule.entitlements.purpose: App entitlements (App Group with the widget).

App/Support/AppTheme.swift.purpose: The kid's chosen look, one per app logo: light/dark colors, type and app icon.

App/Support/ArmenianChrome.swift.purpose: iOS has no Armenian system strings, so "Back", "Edit" and the search "Cancel" would show in English.

App/Support/ArmenianCurriculum.swift.purpose: Official subject lists per grade (ՀՀ ԿԳՄՍՆ, Հանրակրթության պետական չափորոշիչ N 136-Ն), for quick picks in the timetable.

App/Support/Components.swift.purpose: Lesson row reused by Today, Calendar and Notes: colored subject icon first, so it reads before text.

App/Support/HomeworkStreak.swift.purpose: Days in a row (newest first) on which every homework due that day was done.

App/Support/ImageTools.swift.purpose: Image resize helpers for stored photos.

App/Support/LessonRoute.swift.purpose: Navigation value for a lesson on a concrete day.

App/Support/Playful.swift.purpose: Friendly greeting by time of day.

App/Support/ThemeMotion.swift.purpose: Each theme's set of small animations, used across the app through the `themed…` modifiers below.

App/Support/ThemedTabBar.swift.purpose: App tabs and the custom tab bar whose icons play the theme animation on selection.

Scripts/codemap.py.purpose: Keeps .claude/codemap/index.json in step with the repo's files.

Shared/AppGroup.swift.purpose: App Group shared by the app and the widget extension.

Shared/Design/AppLocale.swift.purpose: iOS ships no Armenian UI, so the app pins dates and pickers to `hy_AM` itself rather than following the device region.

Shared/Design/SubjectStyle.swift.purpose: Color + symbol per subject, so children recognise lessons at a glance (before reading).

Shared/Models/Lesson.swift.purpose: One cell of the weekly timetable.

Shared/Models/PeriodTime.swift.purpose: User-editable bell schedule: start/end of a lesson number, in minutes from midnight.

Shared/Persistence/ScheduleReader.swift.purpose: Read-only queries shared by the app, widget and notification scheduler.

Shared/Persistence/SharedModelContainer..purpose: SwiftData schema and container in the App Group.

Shared/Schedule/DaySnapshot.swift.purpose: One day's lessons and tasks as plain values (app, widget, notifications).

Shared/Sharing/SharePackage.swift.purpose: What one kid sends another: a homework task or a whole timetable.

Tests/ArmenianCurriculumTests.swift.purpose: Tests for ArmenianCurriculum and the timetable picker's filter.

Widget/ScheduleProvider.swift.purpose: Widget timeline: entries at lesson boundaries.

Widget/ScheduleWidget.swift.purpose: The schedule widget and its view.

project.yml.purpose: XcodeGen project spec: targets, settings, team and bundle id.
